text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaahhhh!!

—It was overwhelming. Free from tension, 
her ferocious, savage running sought to 
leave everything in the dust—the true 
stride of the mighty...

The conviction I felt the first time I saw 
her run— that "Duramente will become the 
one and only strongest"— came rushing back 
along with the excitement.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Finished the run safely.
choice_data_list:
Good work today! That was an incredible 
run!
Good work today! That was an amazing run!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Was I... strong?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ... Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...How did you know?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Did I have a spacing-out look on my face, 
I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Intuition, huh?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"People around me often say that my 
emotions are hard to read."

Watching from a distance, she certainly 
gave off a cool impression... but talking 
like this, she can be quite 
straightforward. In fact—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
As expected of you, Trainer. It seems your 
mind-reading skills will continue to be a 
great asset moving forward.

...I swallowed back the urge to say, 
'You're actually pretty easy to read.'

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the Make Debut is done. —Next up 
is the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Our plan for the Classic year is set. —The 
Classic Triple Crown route, starting in 
spring.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
“However, I haven't decided on the Junior 
Class yet. I planned to see how things 
went today before thinking about it.”

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I want to hear what you think.

Duramente's raw talent is the real deal. 
When it comes to speed, she is already 
first-class.

However, she still has areas that are 
immature, both physically and mentally. 
First, I want to build a solid foundation 
so she can fully utilize her talent. 
Therefore—
choice_data_list:
I want to focus on training during your 
junior year

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I see.
choice_data_list:
How about making the Kyodo Tsushin Hai our 
first goal?

How about making the Kyodo Tsushin Hai our 
first goal?

text_block_list.text:
A GIII race held in early February, right 
as the Classic year begins. Let's make 
this our tentative target and guide her 
developing body in the right direction.
choice_data_list:
Don't rush; let's grow steadily, step by 
step.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I had a similar plan in mind 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The Kyodo News Hai... A trial race for the 
Satsuki Sho. A crucial contest leading 
into the first jewel of the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Everything I've built up throughout the 
Junior Class, I'll pour it all into this 
race...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: It's settled, then. —First, training.
